name: application-pull-to-refresh
title: Pull-to-Refresh
description: A top-of-list indicator that reveals on overscroll, showing a pull affordance and a refreshing spinner state, for mobile-style list refresh.
useWhen: A scrollable list or feed needs a mobile-native refresh gesture instead of (or alongside) a manual refresh button.
The list is already at its scroll top and overscrolling further should reveal a pull-to-refresh affordance.
avoidWhen: The surface isn't primarily touch-scrolled — desktop-first interfaces should offer a visible refresh button instead of relying on an overscroll gesture.
The list refreshes automatically on an interval or via websocket — a pull gesture would be redundant with data that already stays current.
responsiveBehavior: The indicator sits above the list content within the same overflow container; wire the pull distance and release threshold to whatever touch/scroll library the app uses to detect overscroll.
accessibility: The idle 'Pull to refresh' state uses role="status" so it can be announced if focus lands there, and the arrow icon is decorative (aria-hidden).
The refreshing state uses role="status" with aria-live="polite" so screen reader users are told a refresh is in progress without an interruption.
Always pair the gesture with a non-gesture way to refresh (e.g. a toolbar button) for users who cannot perform a pull gesture.

variants.title: Pull state
variants.description: Idle overscroll-revealed indicator with a downward arrow and 'Pull to refresh' label above a list
accessibility: role="status" allows the pull affordance to be announced if it receives focus.

variants.title: Pull state (Dark)
variants.description: Idle overscroll-revealed indicator with a downward arrow and 'Pull to refresh' label above a list
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: Refreshing state
variants.description: Active refresh indicator with a spinner, dimmed list content beneath while the refresh completes
accessibility: aria-live="polite" announces the refreshing state without interrupting other screen reader output.

variants.title: Refreshing state (Dark)
variants.description: Active refresh indicator with a spinner, dimmed list content beneath while the refresh completes
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
